hooks.command: if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *.py ]]; then ruff check --fix "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *.py ]]; then mypy --no-error-summary --no-pretty "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | tail -10 || true; fi

Stop.command: echo '🛑 Pre-flight: (1) evals run? (2) experiment logged to W&B? (3) data version pinned? (4) CHANGELOG updated? If any are no, continue work.'
